title: Essential Software Installation
description: Install critical HP software and drivers to ensure your OMEN laptop runs at peak performance. This guide covers the essential software every OMEN user should install.

steps.title: Installation Order Matters
steps.content: Install software in the order presented below for best compatibility and to avoid conflicts.

infoBox.title: Important
infoBox.content: Install software in the order presented below for best compatibility and to avoid conflicts.

steps.title: 1. HP Support Assistant
steps.content:
Automatic driver updates and system diagnostics.
**Duration**: 5 minutes
**Priority**: Critical
prerequisites: Download and run the installer from HP's official website
Allow automatic startup for continuous monitoring
Run initial system scan after installation

steps.title: 2. Graphics Drivers (NVIDIA/AMD)
steps.content:
Graphics driver updates and game optimization.
**Duration**: 10 minutes
**Priority**: Important
prerequisites: Download NVIDIA App or AMD Radeon Software

steps.title: Verify Installation
steps.content: After installing all essential software, verify everything is working correctly.

infoBox.title: Verification Checklist
infoBox.content:
• Check HP Support Assistant for any pending updates
  • Open OMEN Gaming Hub and verify all hardware is detected
  • Check graphics driver status in Device Manager
